headline: Retirement Board to approve contribution returns, a retirement application, and review investment and actuarial reports.
summary: The board will consider returning contributions to two members and approving one retirement application. It will also review an actuarial valuation report and a quarterly investment report.
items: Approve return of contribution for Kadeem R. Noel, Class B $4,158.38; Effective Date of Benefit: 09/01/26
